name: mcp
description: Connect external MCP servers to the assistant’s tools.

strings.title: MCP
strings.description: Connect external MCP servers and control who can use their tools.
strings.name: Name
strings.scopeHelp: Personal credentials stay in your account only. Every eligible conversation can use instance servers.
strings.commandHelp: The command and arguments are executed as a local process. Add only a server you explicitly trust.
strings.toolsHint: Tools this server bridges into the assistant. The server itself provides them, so they cannot be edited here.
strings.saveError: Could not save the MCP server.
strings.serverChanged: This MCP server changed or was removed. Close the editor and reopen it before saving.
strings.actionError: The action could not be completed.
strings.removeError: The MCP server could not be removed. It remains configured.

configSchema.label: Timeouts
configSchema.hint: Global connect and call timeouts, applied to every configured server.

configSchema.label: Connect timeout (ms)
configSchema.hint: How long to wait for a server to connect and list its tools before giving up.

configSchema.label: Tool call timeout (ms)
configSchema.hint: How long to wait for a bridged tool call to finish before giving up.
